```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| output: asis

library(daff)

sourceDir <- "../Output/Scenarios/"
model <- "OncoSim-cervical"
specificScenario <- "cervical_45_3_90_CancerSeek"
referenceScenario <- "cervical_BaseCase"

scenarioDirectories <- list.dirs(sourceDir)

specificScenarioPath <- scenarioDirectories[grepl(specificScenario, scenarioDirectories)]
referenceScenarioPath <- scenarioDirectories[grepl(referenceScenario, scenarioDirectories)]


for (parameter in list.files(specificScenarioPath)) {
  currentParamTable <- read.csv(file.path(specificScenarioPath, parameter))
  currentRefTable <- read.csv(file.path(referenceScenarioPath, parameter))

  cat(render_diff(diff_data(currentRefTable, currentParamTable), title = paste(referenceScenario, specificScenario)))
  cat("  \n\n")
}

```
